verdict.rationale: The Marketing Emails API documents retrieving emails "individually or in batches," which is a first-party batch operation, but it covers read-only retrieval only. The pack does not show bulk create, update, archive or delete across many items. Global partial propagation is a template-inheritance feature, not a bulk operation, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: batch write operations (create, update, delete or archive), bulk actions in the UI, documented batch limits and behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You can retrieve existing emails in your account individually or in batches
